name: Bluestone Lane Orange Cafe
tagline: Australian flat whites, avocado smash & wholesome all-day brunch
description: Bringing Melbourne's vibrant coffee culture to Old Towne Orange on North Olive Street, Bluestone Lane is famed for expertly crafted flat whites, cold brews, and a health-forward all-day brunch menu. Highlights include their signature Avocado Smash with poached egg, gluten-free banana bread with whipped ricotta, breakfast brioche rolls, and seasonal rainbow bowls in a sun-drenched, coastal-chic atmosphere.
historicNote: Set in a beautifully restored brick and timber building half a block off The Circle, blending industrial district charm with Melbourne-inspired coastal aesthetics.

specials.title: Morning Melbourne Flat White & Pastry
specials.description: Double shot signature espresso with velvety micro-foam paired with fresh almond or chocolate croissants.

specials.title: Avocado Smash & Cold Brew Pairing
specials.description: Signature smashed avocado on artisanal multigrain with feta, heirloom cherry tomatoes, and draft cold brew.

specials.title: Midweek Wellness Bowls & Golden Lattes
specials.description: Nutrient-packed grain bowls, turmeric golden lattes, and matcha infusions for afternoon rejuvenation.

specials.title: Gluten-Free Banana Bread Tea Time
specials.description: Warm toasted gluten-free banana bread topped with whipped honey ricotta, toasted pecans, and fresh berries.

specials.title: Friday Patio Brunch & Nitro Cold Brew
specials.description: Bacon and egg brioche rolls with house tomato relish and smooth nitrogen-infused cold brews on the patio.

specials.title: Weekend Melbourne Brunch Service
specials.description: Full Australian brunch service featuring poached eggs, chimichurri grain bowls, fresh juices, and mimosas.

specials.title: Sunday Chill & Artisanal Espresso
specials.description: Relax on North Olive Street with pour-overs, iced matcha, and hearty brunch toasts all day until 7 PM.

events.title: Weekend Melbourne Brunch on Olive St
events.description: Enjoy sunny patio brunching steps from the Circle with Melbourne-style flat whites, avocado toasts, and grain bowls.
